title: A Little Princess
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
synopsis: Living off crumbs in a dreary attic, Sara Crewe comforts herself with wondrous stories of adventure and fortune, and in the end the stories become true.
synopsisZh: 住在陰暗閣樓、靠麵包屑度日的莎拉，平常用冒險與幸運的故事安慰自己；最後，這些故事都成真了。

title: Anne of Green Gables
author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
synopsis: Few books or characters in children's literature are more loved or better known than "Anne of Green Gables". Set on the quaint island of Prince Edward Island, this heart-warming tale is about an aging brother and sister, Mathew and Marilla Cuthbert, who decide to adopt a boy to help with chores around their farm. As the result of a misunderstanding, the boy turns out to be none other than Anne, a feisty and lively redhead who is as charming as she is tenacious. At first Mathew and Marilla are at odds as to what “use” Anne might be to them, when Mathew wisely observes that he and Marilla “might be of some use to her.” And thus begins the warm tale of three lives that grow together in the enchanted Avonlea. Despite her characteristic stubborn streak and headstrong ways, Anne wins many friends and admirers in Avonlea, including her best friend and "kindred spirit," Diana, and her handsome admirer, Gilbert Blythe, who often find themselves unintentional victims of Anne's escapades.
synopsisZh: 在兒童文學中，很少有作品或角色比《清秀佳人》更受喜愛、更廣為人知。故事發生在風景如畫的愛德華王子島，一對年邁的兄妹馬修與瑪莉拉・卡斯伯特，決定領養一個男孩來幫忙農場的雜務。沒想到因為一場誤會，來的竟是安妮，一個活潑倔強、既迷人又堅韌的紅髮女孩。起初，馬修與瑪莉拉為了安妮對他們能有什麼「用處」意見分歧，直到馬修說服瑪莉拉：「也許是他們能對她有些用處」。於是，三個人的生命在如詩如畫的淳樸小鎮艾凡里裡逐漸交織，展開一段溫暖的故事。儘管安妮有著固執任性的一面，她仍在艾凡里認識許多朋友，包括她的摯友黛安娜，以及愛慕者吉伯特・布萊斯，而他們也常常成為安妮各種冒險的受害者。

title: Black Beauty
author: Anna Sewell
synopsis: As a young horse, Black Beauty is well-loved and happy. But when his owner is forced to sell him, his life changes drastically. He has many new owners - some of them cruel and some of them kind. All he needs is someone to love him again... Whether pulling an elegant carriage or a ramshackle cab, Black Beauty tries to live as best he can. This is his amazing story, told as only he could tell it.
synopsisZh: 還是小馬的黑神駒曾備受疼愛，過著幸福快樂的日子。但是當主人被迫賣掉牠之後，生活從此天翻地覆。牠換過許多主人，有的殘酷；有的仁慈。牠只希望有人再次愛牠⋯⋯無論牠拉著華麗的馬車，還是破舊的出租馬車，黑神駒都努力活下去。精彩的一生，由牠親口娓娓道來。

title: Don Quixote
author: Miguel de Cervantes
synopsis: An elderly gentleman reads too many chivalric romances, names himself a knight, and rides out at windmills with Sancho Panza behind him.
synopsisZh: 一位年長的紳士讀了太多騎士小說，便自封為騎士，帶著侍從桑丘騎馬出征，向風車發起戰鬥邀請。

title: Gulliver's Travels
author: Jonathan Swift
synopsis: A ship's surgeon is wrecked among the tiny Lilliputians, the giant Brobdingnagians and stranger nations still.
synopsisZh: 一位船醫遭遇船難後，先後流落到小人國、巨人國，以及更多奇異的國度。

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
synopsis: This story of four sisters, Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy, will forever be part of American literature and culture. Set in the mid-1800s in a small New England town, Louisa May Alcott takes the reader into the home of these sisters as they confront the struggles of their absent father, off fighting in the Civil War, having to mature and grow up supporting themselves, and learning about and sharing the joys of love, children, and the sadness of death. This book is a true American classic.
synopsisZh: 梅格、喬、貝絲與艾美四姊妹的故事，已永遠成為美國文學與文化的一部分。故事背景是十九世紀中葉美國的一個小鎮，作者露意莎・梅帶領讀者走進四姊妹的家：父親遠赴南北戰爭前線，她們必須面對生活的困境，學習自立、長大，也體會愛情與家庭的喜悅，以及死亡帶來的悲傷。這是一部美國經典的必讀故事。

title: Peter Pan
author: J.M. Barrie
synopsis: The boy who will not grow up takes the Darling children to Neverland, where they meet the Lost Boys, the fairy Tinker Bell and Captain Hook.
synopsisZh: 永遠不想長大的男孩彼得潘，帶著達林家的孩子們飛往夢幻島，在那裡遇見了迷失男孩、小仙子叮噹，以及邪惡的虎克船長。

title: Robinson Crusoe
author: Daniel Defoe
synopsis: Shipwrecked alone, Crusoe builds a shelter, raises goats and grain, and after years finds a single footprint in the sand.
synopsisZh: 魯賓遜不幸遭逢船難，而獨自漂流荒島，他自己搭建住所、飼養山羊、種植穀物；多年之後，他在沙灘上發現了一個陌生的腳印。

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
synopsis: Twelve cases narrated by Dr Watson, from the woman who outwits Holmes to the speckled band and the red-headed league.
synopsisZh: 由華生醫生講述十二件神探福爾摩斯案子，從智勝福爾摩斯的那位女士，到〈花斑帶探案〉、〈紅髮俱樂部〉。

title: The Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
synopsis: Buck is stolen from a California ranch into the Klondike gold rush, learns the law of club and fang, and answers the wild at last.
synopsisZh: 家犬巴克從加州的農場被偷走，賣到冰天雪地的克隆岱當雪橇狗，在狗群中學會了棍棒與獠牙的法則，最終回應荒野的呼喚。

title: The Canterbury Tales
author: Geoffrey Chaucer
synopsis: Pilgrims riding to Canterbury pass the time with stories, from the Knight's romance to the Pardoner's sermon on greed.
synopsisZh: 一群前往坎特伯雷朝聖的旅人，在路上輪流說故事打發時間，從騎士的浪漫傳奇，到天主教贖罪券的腐敗。

title: The Merry Adventures of Robin Hood
author: Howard Pyle
synopsis: Howard Pyle's retelling of the outlaw of Sherwood, Little John, Friar Tuck and the Sheriff of Nottingham.
synopsisZh: 霍華德・派里 重新講述雪伍德森林中俠盜羅賓漢，以及小約翰、塔克修士與諾丁漢郡長的故事。

title: The Tale of Peter Rabbit
author: Beatrix Potter
synopsis: Peter disobeys his mother, squeezes under Mr McGregor's gate, loses his jacket and shoes, and is sent to bed with camomile tea.
synopsisZh: 彼得兔不聽媽媽的話，硬是鑽過麥奎格先生的菜園柵門，弄丟外套和鞋子。最後他被送上床，喝了一杯洋甘菊茶。

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
synopsis: The Time Machine was published in 1895 and quickly established Wells not only as an able writer, but a thinker of unusual ideas. Wells is perhaps the original writer of science fiction (alongside Jules Verne) and this novel is characteristic of his use of technology, imagination, and clever plotting to make the unthinkable seem plausible to the ordinary reader.
synopsisZh: 《時光機器》出版於1895年，讓威爾斯被視為一位出色的作家，更譽為一位擁有非凡想法的思想家。威爾斯或許可說是科幻小說的始祖之一，這部小說充分展現他的特色：運用科技、想像力與巧妙的情節，讓不可思議的事在一般讀者眼中也合情合理。

title: The Travels of Marco Polo
author: Marco Polo
synopsis: The Venetian's account of twenty-four years on the road to Kublai Khan's court, and the cities, customs and wealth he reports.
synopsisZh: 這位威尼斯人寫下他從義大利前往忽必烈汗宮廷、長達二十四年的旅程，揭開東方世界的面紗，以及沿途所見的城市與風俗。

title: The Wind in the Willows
author: Kenneth Grahame
synopsis: The Wind in the Willows is a book for those "who keep the spirit of youth alive in them; of life, sunshine, running water, woodlands, dusty roads, winter firesides." So wrote Kenneth Grahame of his timeless tale of Rat, Mole, Badger, and Toad in their lyrical world of gurgling rivers and whispering reeds, a world that is both beautiful and benevolently ordered. But it is also a world threatened by dark forces-"the Terror of the Wild Wood" with its "wicked little faces" and "glances of malice and hatred"-and defended by the mysterious Piper at the Gates of Dawn. In the end, Grahame triumphantly succeeds in conveying his most precious theme: the miracle of loyalty and friendship. Since its first publication in 1908, generations of adults and children have cherished this classic. A.A. Milne described it as "a Household Book; a book which everybody in the household loves, and quotes continually; a book which is read aloud to every new guest and is regarded as the touchstone of his worth."
synopsisZh: 作者肯尼斯．葛拉罕說《柳林風聲》是寫給那些心中仍保有青春精神的人；寫給生命、陽光、流水、林地、塵土飛揚的小路與冬日爐火。這部永恆的經典描寫河鼠、鼴鼠、獾與蟾蜍在潺潺河流與低語蘆葦之間的生活，那是一個美麗而井然有序的世界。但這個世界也受到黑暗力量的威脅。最終，葛拉罕成功傳達他最重視的主題：忠誠與友誼的奇蹟。自1908年首次出版以來，一代又一代的大人與孩子都珍愛這部經典。小熊維尼的作者A.A. 米恩稱它是「一本家庭之書；一本家裡每個人都喜愛、不斷引用的作品；一本會朗讀給每位新客人聽、並藉此檢驗品味的經典」。

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
synopsis: This, the complete and unabridged original tale that provided us with the best-loved classic movie, stands on its own as a great modern fairy tale. Dorothy, her dog, Toto, and her companions, the Tin Woodsman, the Scarecrow, and the Cowardly Lion, are characters who endure in the hearts of children and adults alike. Join them on their enchanting journey as they follow the Yellow Brick Road in search of the wonderful Wizard in the enchanted Emerald City.
synopsisZh: 這是完整未刪節的原著故事，也是備受喜愛的電影原作，這部作品本身就是一部偉大的現代童話。桃樂絲、她的小狗托托，以及她的夥伴錫樵夫、稻草人和膽小獅，都是永遠留在大人與孩子心中的角色。跟著他們沿著黃磚路，前往魔法翡翠城尋找神奇的巫師，展開一段迷人的旅程吧。

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
synopsis: “Shiver me timbers,” this is Robert Louis Stevenson's unforgettable tale of swashbuckling and adventure on the high seas. Young Jim Hawkins comes into possession of a treasure map and finds himself and his mates in a dangerous race with a crew of ruthless pirates in search of the treasure. Jim and the ship's crew must brave the elements and a mutinous charge led by the ruthless pirate Long John Silver. Brilliantly conceived and splendidly executed, this novel has captured the imagination of generations of adults and children alike, earning a place as the best and most influential of all pirate stories.
synopsisZh: 這是羅伯特・路易斯・史蒂文森令人難忘的冒險故事。少年吉姆意外得到一張藏寶圖，和夥伴們捲入一場與冷酷海盜爭奪寶藏的危險比賽。他們必須對抗惡劣的天候，還要面對狡猾的海盜「高個子」約翰所帶領的叛變。這部構思精巧、筆法出色的小說，擄獲了一代又一代大人與孩子的心，被譽為所有海盜故事中最好、也最有影響力的一部。

title: Aesop's Fables
author: Aesop
synopsis: A collection of the best-loved of Aesop’s Fables including: The Fox and the Grapes The Hare and the Tortoise and The Town Mouse & the Country Mouse
synopsisZh: 收錄最受喜愛的伊索寓言，包括〈狐狸與葡萄〉、〈龜兔賽跑〉以及〈城市老鼠和鄉下老鼠〉。

title: Aladdin and the Magic Lamp
synopsis: A poor Persian boy finds his life transformed when he acquires a magical lamp, and with the help of the kind genie who lives in the lamp, Aladdin fights an evil magician and wins the hand of a beautiful princess.
synopsisZh: 一個貧窮的波斯男孩得到一盞神燈後，人生從此改變。在神燈裡善良精靈的幫助下，阿拉丁打敗邪惡魔法師，並贏得美麗公主的芳心。

title: Around the World in 80 Days
author: Jules Verne
synopsis: This travel adventure novel by Jules Verne was published serially in 1872 and in book form in 1873. The lively and amusing narrative recounts the journey pursued by a sedentary London gentleman named Phileas Fogg and his valet, Passepartout, to win a wager with Fogg's fellow club members. Pursued by Fix, a private detective who believes Fogg to be a bank robber, the duo cross three continents and two oceans on trains, steamers, an elephant, and a sail-sledge. Delays and death-defying exploits abound as Fogg continues his course, undeterred and forever maintaining the firm resolve of a good English gentleman. Assorted companions join the party, including the Hindu widow Aouda, rescued by Fogg from ritual immolation. Fogg returns to London just in the nick of time, none the worse for the wear, to win his bet and proceed with his orderly life.
synopsisZh: 這部儒勒・凡爾納的旅行冒險故事於1872年開始連載，1873年出版成書。描述一位生活規律的倫敦紳士菲萊亞・福格與他的僕人路路通，為了贏得與俱樂部會友的賭注而展開的環球旅程。私家偵探費克斯認定福格是銀行搶匪，一路緊追不捨；兩人旅程中搭乘火車、輪船、大象與帆橇，橫越三大洲與兩大洋。旅途中延誤與驚險不斷，福格始終堅守英國紳士的沉著與決心。途中也有其他夥伴加入，包括被福格從殉葬儀式中救出的印度寡婦艾娥達。最後，福格在千鈞一髮之際回到倫敦贏得賭注，繼續過著他井然有序的生活。

title: Hans Brinker or The Silver Skates
author: Mary Mapes Dodge
synopsis: This delightful story follows the tale of a Dutch brother and sister who work together toward two goals--finding the doctor who can restore their father's memory and winning the competition for the silver skates. This book was first published in 1865 and received more reviews than any other children's book that year. It continues to delight countless readers with its story of a virtuous and hardworking family who inspires us all to have the courage to pursue our dreams, and the dreams of those we love.
synopsisZh: 這個溫馨的故事描述一對荷蘭兄妹齊心努力，追尋兩個目標：找到能恢復父親記憶的醫生，以及贏得銀冰鞋比賽。本書首次出版於1865年，當年廣受好評。這個善良勤奮的家庭故事至今仍感動無數讀者，鼓勵我們鼓起勇氣，追求自己的夢想，也追求所愛之人的夢想。

title: Tarzan of the Apes
author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
synopsis: First published in 1914, this romantic novel has remained influential over the years, both as a book and in films and a television series. The reader must recognize that Tarzan is a product of its age and contains outmoded imagery and simplistic depictions of other cultures and species: bloodthirsty natives, chatty chimps, roaring lions, stalking beasts. In some respects Tarzan is a caricature of itself and life in an African jungle. Burroughs balances such incorrectness, however, with descriptions of vile elements of white civilization -- mutinous, murderous sailors, narcissistic aristocrats, self-involved academics, and hard-hearted cowards. At the center of the story lies the muscular, yet innocent, and noble title character, a man increasingly torn between the civil and the savage, for whom cutlery is a nightmare, equally so are the pretensions of “civil” society that tries to control and subdue nature and wildlife, rather than seek to understand it. Through Tarzan's eyes we see that civilized "men were indeed more foolish and more cruel than the beasts of the jungle," a powerful idea as relevant today as when this book was written.
synopsisZh: 這部小說首次出版於1914年，多年來無論是書本、電影或電視影集都深具影響力。《泰山》是那個時代的產物，書中含有過時的意象，以及對其他文化與物種的刻板印象：嗜血的原住民、多話的黑猩猩、咆哮的獅子、潛伏的野獸。在某些方面，它可說是對自身與非洲叢林生活的誇張描繪。不過，柏洛茲也以白人文明中醜惡的一面加以平衡——叛變殺人的水手、自戀的貴族、自我中心的學者，以及冷酷的懦夫。故事的核心是一名在文明與野性之間掙扎的主角，對他來說，文明禮儀是一場惡夢，社會的虛偽在於試圖控制、征服自然與野生動物，而非理解它們。透過泰山的角度，我們看見人類比叢林裡的野獸更加愚蠢、更殘忍」，這個觀點在今日仍切中人類文明的要害。

title: The Adventures of Pinocchio
author: Carlo Collodi
synopsis: The puppet master Geppetto has obtained a new puppet who not only can dance and turn somersaults, but also talk and misbehave—his name is Pinocchio and if the truth be told, he longs to be a real boy. This book recounts the adventures of Pinocchio -- the puppet who wants to be a little boy and whose nose grew longer whenever he told a lie.
synopsisZh: 木偶師傅傑佩托得到一個新木偶，它不但會跳舞、翻筋斗，還會說話、調皮搗蛋，它的名字叫皮諾丘，它渴望成為一個真正的男孩。本書講述皮諾丘的冒險：一個想變成小男孩、每次說謊鼻子就會變長的木偶。

title: The Jungle Book
author: Rudyard Kipling
synopsis: For the past one hundred years, Rudyard Kipling's classic tales of Mowgli, the lost boy raised by wolves in the jungles of India, have captivated children and adults alike. Mowgli's days are filled with danger, wonder, and excitement. He learns the ways of the jungle from the wise old bear, Baloo, and the great black panther, Bagheera. He is befriended by the faithful wolf, Gray Brother, and is carried off by the crafty Monkey-People -- only to be rescued by the mighty python, Kaa. And through it all, Mowgli knows that he must someday face his sworn enemy: the ferocious man-hating tiger, Shere Khan.
synopsisZh: 一百年來，吉卜林筆下的經典故事，始終深深吸引著大人與孩子，在印度叢林中被狼群養大的迷失男孩毛克利，他的每一天都充滿危險、驚奇與刺激。他跟著睿智的老熊巴魯和黑豹巴希拉學習叢林法則，與忠心的灰狼成為好友，也曾被狡猾的猴群擄走，最後被強大的巨蟒卡阿救出。而在這一切之中，毛克利知道，總有一天他必須面對他的死敵：痛恨人類的兇猛老虎謝利汗。

title: The Story of Doctor Dolittle
author: Hugh Lofting
synopsis: Doctor Dolittle is a 19th-century English physician who has never been one for worrying much. After his human patients desert him (when one too many sit on one of his unusual parlor pets), he converts his practice gracefully to animal medicine. Having mastered animal language along the way (with the help of his caustic yet amusing parrot, Polynesia), he is well on his way to a thriving practice. Then, one cold, dark winter night, as the doctor and his pets sit around the fire, a message arrives, via sparrow, from Africa. A terrible epidemic has broken out among the monkeys, and Doctor Dolittle is the only one who can save them. And so off he goes. Originally published in 1920, The Story of Doctor Dolittle has delighted and amused countless millions of children all over the world. Lofting's playful description of the animals and Doctor Dolittle's clear affection for his patients, one and all, make this a book that will bring a smile to the face of readers of all ages.
synopsisZh: 杜立德醫生是一位十九世紀的英國醫生，向來不太為事情操心。當他的病人紛紛離去之後，他改行當起動物醫生。在說話尖酸卻逗趣的鸚鵡波里尼西亞幫助下，他學會動物的語言，診所也漸漸興旺起來。某個寒冷黑暗的冬夜，醫生和寵物們正圍坐在爐火旁，一隻麻雀從非洲捎來消息：猴子之間爆發了可怕的瘟疫，只有杜立德醫生能救牠們。於是，他啟程了。《杜立德醫生的故事》首次出版於 1920年，帶給全世界數以百萬計的孩子歡樂。羅夫汀對動物生動有趣的描寫，以及杜立德醫生對每一位病人真摯的關愛，讓這本書能為各個年齡層的讀者帶來微笑。
